title: Intervention-Compatible Chess Concepts, Pawn-Structure Edit Grammar, Root-Pair Positivity, Matched Sham Controls & Factorial Engine-Budget-Continuation Falsification
theorem: Isolated and passed pawn counts in the current C3X chess-concept implementation depend only on pawn-square/color arrangements. Any P15 one-non-pawn edit leaves all pawn arrangements fixed, hence cannot toggle either. A pawn's ordinary noncapture forward move remains on its pawn file, so cannot toggle isolated-pawn status; it can change passed-pawn status when passing enemy-pawn ranks. A material-preserving diagonal empty-square pawn translocation may produce a valid board but is not a legal one-move trajectory.
proof_boundary: Mathematical invariance of coded pawn-only feature functions, not a universal legal chess-board causal theorem or explanation of engine behavior.

test_cases: P16 historical B0/TARGET/SHAM preserve exact pawn-square/color signatures and pawn features
Legal forward pawn move toggles passed status while leaving isolation invariant
Synthetic isolation-changing file translocation yields a valid board but NOT a legal move
Historical P16 concept_label null and local-only replication retained

not_earned: P6 legal matched target/sham engine preference reversal
pawn isolation mechanism in genuinely legal move histories
next: Construct source-disjoint root-pair-preserving target/sham grammar stratified by nonpawn and pawn-structure edits. Explicitly distinguish synthetic legal-board edits from real one-move/real-game reachability; if no admissible intervention toggles concept, issue SUPPORT_HOLD rather than causal explanation.
